sites.why: Global llama-index Settings.llm (llama_index.llms.openai.OpenAI) used for sub-question generation and default LLM calls across query engines. Model is gpt-4o-mini, a standard catalog model, so no model-map was needed. Wrapped the client's http_client/async_http_client with the Router runtime; check --all confirms it now routes. No functionality is given up.

Chat-facing OpenAIAgent's streaming chat LLM (llama_index.llms.openai.OpenAI), used for the main conversational agent with function-calling tools over SEC documents. Model is gpt-4o-mini, a standard catalog model. Wrapped the client's http_client/async_http_client with the Router runtime; check --all confirms it now routes. Streaming and function-calling both pass through Router's /v1/responses translation unchanged, so no functionality is given up.
